ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that: (i) the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner and, for a period of 90 days following performance, will conform to their documentation; (ii) for a period of 12 months following delivery, the Interface, all related software and all deliverables will conform to their documentation; (iii) the Interface and all related software will be free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code; and (iv) TrueLink will comply with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement. Client's remedy for breach of the foregoing warranties is repair, replacement or refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming services, Interface, software or deliverables.

input.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 warrants only Year 2000 date handling, so TrueLink gives no warranty that the Interface conforms to its documentation or that the Hosting and Support Services will be competently performed.
